plugins.name: chart
plugins.summary: chart hledger's numbers in a window: chart [options] <type> [query]
plugins.help: Opens a chart of hledger's own numbers in a window of its own. Chart options come first and shape the picture; then the type; then the query, which goes to hledger as you write it, so anything balance takes works there. A chart over time is monthly unless the query names an interval. A one-period chart can be played through every period with --animate. The window shows the command it ran, related charts to follow, and the numbers as a table.

plugins.name: edit
plugins.summary: edit a loaded journal in a window
plugins.help: Opens a file in an editor window, with Ctrl+S or Cmd+S writing it back to disk. With no argument it edits the journal hledger is reading. Only files from an open folder can be written: everything else opens read-only, and the save says so. If the file changed on disk since it was opened, the save is refused rather than overwriting the change.

sections.title: In the window
rows: save the file back to disk, if it came from an open folder

examples: another file from the open folder

plugins.name: reconcile
plugins.summary: check an account against a statement, in a window
plugins.help: Opens a window on an account's postings since its last balance assertion. Already cleared lines are hidden, so it opens on what is left. Lines in another currency are shown but marked as not counted, and the window says which currency it counts and how to count another. The statement date defaults to today. Type the closing balance and tick the lines the statement shows until the difference is zero. Save changes writes the ticks, edits and date changes; Finish writes them and a balance assertion, then runs hledger to check it, putting the files back if it fails. Every write is shown first. Only files from an open folder can be written.
